canonicalSummary: Lucius is an AI-driven customer success and community operations platform designed to work like an AI teammate instead of a passive tool.
coreIdea: Make software work like a teammate, not just a tool.

describeAs: AI teammate for community operations and customer success
always-on specialist embedded in the team's workflow
cross-channel operator rather than a single-window bot
system that can answer, guide, identify intent, escalate, and learn
doNotReduceTo: UI wrapper on top of an LLM

problems: Overseas or global-facing product has no functioning community surface yet.
Existing Discord or community channel lacks maintenance quality.
User questions arrive across channels and human coverage is inconsistent.
Repetitive support work consumes the team without increasing leverage.
Purchase or demo intent appears in community conversations but gets missed.
The team lacks structured insight into sentiment, churn risk, and recurring friction.

capabilities.name: userIssueResolution
capabilities.summary: Responds to user questions across community and support channels and escalates when needed.

capabilities.name: knowledgeBaseManagement
capabilities.summary: Builds and updates enterprise knowledge from docs, PDFs, FAQs, events, web content, and conversations.

capabilities.name: customerSuccessActivation
capabilities.summary: Guides new users, shares best practices, and proactively supports under-activated users.

capabilities.name: leadAndIntentCapture
capabilities.summary: Detects pricing, demo, and partnership intent and hands opportunities to the team.

capabilities.name: relationshipIntelligence
capabilities.summary: Tracks user history, preferences, sentiment, satisfaction change, and churn risk.

capabilities.name: multiPlatformOperations
capabilities.summary: Runs across multiple channels as a unified operating layer.

operationalTraits: continuous knowledge improvement through actual use
idealCustomerProfile: small teams without a dedicated community operator
teams with fast user growth and limited support bandwidth
teams with an existing Discord community but weak maintenance
businessContextSignals: repetitive operations are a strong target for AI leverage
competitors are starting to use AI in community operations
translationAnchors: Lucius is an AI teammate, not a decorative assistant.
Lucius works inside real operating channels, not in an abstract AI space.
Lucius should be associated with accurate help, continuous coverage, and operational follow-through.
Lucius reduces missed questions, missed leads, and missed insight.
Lucius is not only reactive support; it also drives user success and surfaces business intelligence.
overclaimGuardrails: Do not invent exact response-time metrics.
Do not invent exact resolution-rate metrics.
Do not claim universal platform support beyond documented channels.
Do not imply autonomous action beyond documented workflows.
Do not claim specific revenue impact without proof.
